How to run a script (tutorial)
  1. Open the website where you want the effect (any tab — Google, a quiz, a friend’s screen, etc.).
  2. Open Developer Tools: press F12, or right‑click the page → Inspect.
  3. Click the Console tab (you may need to click >> to see it).
  4. On this page, pick an effect and click Copy script.
  5. Click inside the console (the area with the > prompt).
  6. Paste: Ctrl+V (Mac: Cmd+V).
  7. Press Enter. The script runs on that page only.
  8. To stop an effect, copy and run the matching Turn off … script from the same tab, or refresh the page.

First time pasting? Chrome and Edge often block paste in the console. After Ctrl+V, if nothing appears, type allow pasting and press Enter. Then click in the console again and paste (Ctrl+V) one more time, then Enter.

On this hub you can click Test here instead — no console needed. Effects disappear when you refresh the tab.
